name: quorate-workspace
description: A multi-agent code review council for local CLI and GitHub PR workflows.

scripts.build:js: npm run build --workspace @quorate/core && npm run build --workspace quorate && npm run build --workspace @quorate/github-action
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli && tsc -p packages/github-action/tsconfig.check.json && npm run compile --workspace quorate-vscode
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run package:vscode && npx vitest run
scripts.dev:website: npm run generate:command-docs && npm run dev --workspace @quorate/website
scripts.build:website: npm run generate:command-docs && npm run build --workspace @quorate/website
